title: Reinforcement Learning Benchmarks for Traffic Signal Control
evidence: real-world scenarios, matched configurable state/reward/action, Fixed Time/Max Pressure/Max Wave baselines
decision: adopt matched-controller and held-out-scenario evaluation principles

title: Microscopic Traffic Simulation using SUMO
evidence: SUMO is an open microscopic traffic simulator with programmatic control
decision: use SUMO for the calibrated motorcycle pilot

title: SUMO Sublane Model documentation
evidence: supports multiple two-wheelers in one lane, continuous lateral position, virtual lanes and calibrated lateral parameters; smaller resolution increases runtime
decision: pilot lateral-resolution and motorcycle parameters before scaling

title: Application of Dueling Double Deep Q-Network for Dynamic Traffic Signal Optimization: A Case Study in Danang City, Vietnam
evidence: Da Nang 103-s three-phase plan; 6171 PCU/h peak turning table from 2022 transport-department data; 12-hour profile with AM/PM peaks
decision: primary observed-data pilot and comparison source

title: Optimizing traffic management in Danang: a comparative study of multi-object tracking techniques for real-time vehicle flow monitoring
decision: do not infer downloadable counts until verified

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
evidence: few-run point estimates and conventional uncertainty can be unreliable; recommends robust aggregate evaluation
decision: report per-case/per-seed values, intervals and effect sizes; avoid zero-variance reused baselines

title: Max pressure control of a network of signalized intersections
evidence: foundational pressure controller and stability conditions
decision: retain Max-Pressure as a required strong baseline and state theorem assumptions
